what: intersect of a two-lump target (two spheres joined while apart) with a box holding the bottom half of each
method: box x -10..40, y -10..10, z -10..0 holds the z<=0 half of each r=4 sphere (centres (0,0,0), (30,0,0)): V = 2 * (2/3) pi 4^3 = 268.083. The body must not be removed. One body with two shells. The second sphere is joined with touching: one_body, which makes the two-lump target (a join keeps solids that share no volume as separate bodies by default, owner decision 2026-10-22).
